scope: 5 newly recognized components, 5 fully supported older native Dimensional Hand prints needed by current ME5-5 Memory Helix. No Mew support claimed; prior supported programs and metadata unchanged.
source: Rainier English card text included verbatim per component; conversion input matched by stable card ID.

ruleReferences.usedFor: Official YES: Memory Helix Mew on the Bench may use a Benched Alakazam ex Dimensional Hand, so native Bench attack declarations are required. Native Bench Alakazam also remains the actual attacker for Deluxe Bomb and Energy movement reactions; Active restrictions must not substitute another Pokemon as attacker.
